info.name: Pivot Banking - Master Collection (Phase I)
info.description:
Master End-to-End Postman Collection for the Pivot Banking System.

Includes centralized variables, automated variable chaining, and test assertions across all 5 microservices:
1. **ms-config (:8888):** Centralized configuration server.
2. **ms-customer (:8081):** Personal & Business customer management.
3. **ms-account (:8082):** Passive bank products (Savings, Checking, Fixed-Term).
4. **ms-credit (:8083):** Active bank products (Personal/Business Loans & Credit Cards).
5. **ms-transaction (:8084):** Immutable Financial Ledger & Transaction Orchestrator.
